# VidaExtra — Spanish retrospective

- Original source: [Retroanálisis de Robin Hood: La Leyenda de Sherwood, el noble Commandos medieval](https://www.vidaextra.com/analisis/robin-hood-leyenda-sherwood-analisis-review-precio-experiencia-juego-para-pc)
- Author / publication: Jarkendia; VidaExtra.
- Language / date: Spanish; 2020-06-12.
- Access: Article body and verdict inspected.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Jarkendia praises the medieval setting, attractive towns, and complementary character abilities. The review discusses learning mouse-drawn sword attacks, managing stamina, and finding alternate routes such as rooftops.

Its strongest criticism is repeated scenery, especially forest areas, alongside limited mission variety and combat controls that need refinement. The author still regards the game fondly and would welcome a remaster. This offers a useful counterpoint to reviews that emphasize mission variety: discovering routes remains rewarding here, but repeated locations weaken the overall campaign experience.
